workerWalk.prompt: Create a transparent photorealistic WALK-CYCLE SPRITE SHEET for the exact Korean male industrial worker in his 40s in input 1. Input 2 shows the intended photorealistic workwear texture and sprite sheet approach, but FIX the cycle: it currently repeats the same leg direction. One sheet, precisely THREE equal-width columns by TWO equal-height rows, six separate full-body right-facing SIDE PROFILE frames, all same character height and same ground baseline inside each cell. Absolutely real transparent background with no ground, no shadows, no background fill, no grid, no text or labels. All frames stay strictly facing RIGHT; do not rotate viewpoints. Same white hard hat and chin strap, navy jacket/trousers, muted yellow reflective vest, gray gloves, brown-black safety boots, natural Korean facial features and proportions. Preserve identity from image1, no duplicate foreign face. Six sequential walk frames in reading order: (1) neutral standing idle, feet together, arms relaxed; (2) LEFT foot forward contacting ground and RIGHT foot far behind, RIGHT arm forward; (3) passing phase with LEFT foot planted, RIGHT knee passing forward, opposing arms; (4) RIGHT foot forward contacting ground and LEFT foot far behind, LEFT arm forward; (5) passing phase with RIGHT foot planted, LEFT knee passing forward, opposing arms; (6) late swing approaching LEFT forward contact. Distinct alternating legs is critical: both contact frames must NOT be copies of the same step. Low modest industrial walking stride, no exaggerated running, no hops. Feet must NOT get cropped, helmet fully visible, consistent scale and body height. Keep ample horizontal padding within each exact cell; none overlap. Photographic industrial realism, no cartoon, pixelart, low-poly, miniature or neon. No symbols, logos, words, watermark, readable or fake text. No injuries or accidents.
